query:
SELECT i.id AS "issue_id!: i64",
                  i.series_id AS "series_id!: i64",
                  COALESCE(i.store_date, i.cover_date) AS "release_date?: String"
           FROM issues i
           JOIN series s ON s.id = i.series_id
           WHERE NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM files f
               WHERE f.issue_id = i.id
                 AND f.status = 'owned'
                 AND f.is_present = 1
           )
